To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the Internet of Things can provide a wide range of benefits for end-users, but (2) these benefits can be maximized if the Internet of Things is used to enhance the user experience, and (3) this can be achieved by using the Internet of Things to (a) provide users with relevant information, (b) allow users to control the environment, and (c) provide users with feedback on their behavior.
the Internet of Things can be used to enhance the user experience of smart environments.

the user experience of smart environments can be enhanced through: •	An understanding of the user’s context, including their location, identity, and activity, •	A focus on providing users with relevant, actionable information, •	The use of a variety of communication channels, and •	Integration with the user’s other systems and applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and evaluation of Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled applications that can be used to engage a wide variety of end users in smart environments.
how to create a user experience that will engage a wide range users and encourage them to take action to improve their water and energy use.
how to design and develop applications to support a wide range of user needs, interests, and priorities within a smart environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a smart environment is not just a set of sensors and actuators, but also a set of people, and the interaction between the two is what makes the smart environment smart.
the IoT is not the answer to all problems and that the user experience should be considered at the design and implementation stage of the IoT system.

the Internet of Things is a powerful technology that can be used to create smart applications for a wide variety of environments, but the user experience needs to be designed with the end users in mind.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Internet of Things (IoT) is a key enabler for creating an engaging user experience for smart environments, and that it is important to understand the different needs of different users and to design and deploy applications that are appropriate for the different contexts of use.
it is possible to create a user experience that is engaging for a broad range of end users.
it is not easy to create a smart environment, but it can be done with a good user experience and a solid Internet-of-Things infrastructure.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Internet of Things is an enabling technology that can be used to create an effective user experience for smart environments.
the user experience is an essential component of a successful smart environment.

a smart environment can be made accessible to a broad range of users by focusing on three key aspects of the user experience: (i) providing users with a clear understanding of their energy and water consumption; (ii) providing users with an understanding of how they can change their behavior to reduce their consumption; and (iii) providing users with the tools they need to take action.
